verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an on-prem offering that runs its models on customer-controlled infrastructure, including air-gapped deployment, a downloadable container, and a maintained Helm chart for Kubernetes. Its core engines (Marker, Surya, Chandra) are also free open source. This covers both the own-VPC and fully self-hosted paths, but the managed on-prem stack requires an Enterprise contract. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments, and detailed docs on VPC networking, egress, and licensing beyond the overview and Helm/container pages.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run the extraction stack in my own VPC or fully self-hosted when documents can't leave my infrastructure
